Frequency your Intelligence modifier times per day, minimum once

Trigger A Signal-declared effect of yours fails

Traits Paradise-Touched

You take double the force damage the failure would deal and gain no Signal Drift from it. Double means double whatever your Signal failure damage currently is: 4 force damage per level normally, or 6 per level if you have Signal Mastery. The damage cannot be reduced or avoided by any means, and the Drift point is avoided entirely rather than delayed.
